registration.label: Create a Matrix.org account in your browser

freeUseLimits.summary: The documented free plan allows attachments up to 10 MB and 100 MB of data per 24 hours. Accounts not yet assigned to a plan may have different fair-use limits.

notes: Public service operated independently by the Matrix.org Foundation.
Requires users to be at least 18 and to accept the operator's current terms.
Availability, registration requirements, and limits may change.

jurisdiction: Germany; service infrastructure in Germany and Finland

registration.label: Create a tchncs.de account in your browser

freeUseLimits.summary: The reviewed operator pages do not publish a current numeric upload allowance. Registration requires email, terms acceptance, and Google reCAPTCHA.

notes: Public community service operated independently from Mesh.
The operator reports seven-day IP logging and describes current retention limitations on its privacy page.
Create accounts in the operator's web client because reCAPTCHA is restricted to approved browser origins.

jurisdiction: Germany; dedicated server and daily backups in Germany

registration.label: Create a quassel.io account in your browser

freeUseLimits.summary: The operator publishes a 150 MB attachment limit and no daily upload allowance. Registration may be paused to control spam.

notes: Small hobby-operated public service, independent from Mesh, with no uptime guarantee.
The operator requires users to be at least 18.
Registration currently requires email and may be paused at the operator's discretion.
